name: CineDock
description: Rediscover your library. CineDock gives Plex, Emby or Jellyfin an enhanced browsing experience on the NVIDIA Shield TV, on an Amazon Fire TV Stick, or in a browser on your computer or tablet.

paths.name: Config folder
paths.description: Where CineDock stores its server connection and small caches.

ports.name: Web port
ports.description: The port you open in your browser to use CineDock.

variables.name: TMDB API key (optional)
variables.description: Optional. A free TMDB key adds actor biographies, filmographies and improves spotlight selection. It does not supply trailer video files. CineDock works without it.

variables.name: Emby server address (optional)
variables.description: Optional. Full Emby address, for example http://192.168.1.20:8096. Add it with the API key to make TV setup a single connection test.

variables.name: Emby API key (optional)
variables.description: Optional. Store the Emby API key in the container so it does not need to be entered on the television setup screen.

variables.name: Jellyfin server address (optional)
variables.description: Optional. Full Jellyfin address, for example http://192.168.1.20:8096. Add it with the API key to make TV setup a single connection test.

variables.name: Jellyfin API key (optional)
variables.description: Optional. Store the Jellyfin API key in the container so it does not need to be entered on the television setup screen.

variables.name: Plex server address (optional)
variables.description: Optional. Full local Plex address, for example http://192.168.1.20:32400. Add it with the token to make Plex immediately selectable; secure account linking remains available when blank.

variables.name: Plex token (optional)
variables.description: Optional. Store the Plex token in the container for immediate server switching, or leave blank to use secure Plex account linking.
